topics.description: Investigations into welfare fraud in Minnesota are ongoing, with explosive claims linking Somalia president Mohamud to the fraud. The state is also off-loading fraud cases onto federal investigators due to an overwhelming backlog.

topics.description: The FBI is currently investigating several high-profile cases, including child pornography and corruption. Recent raids on the offices of Virginia State Senator Louise Lucas and a nearby weed dispensary she co-owns have raised concerns about the scope of the investigations.
